cues: Church spires are the tallest things in town, so they catch the light first.
Amethyst is a violet jewel, and in the Book of Revelation it is one of the stones in the wall of heaven, so for a moment the town is built into heaven.
And swam turns the air into water.
Then the only simile in the poem: the news like squirrels ran.
The light runs down into the streets in bursts, like a squirrel.
